notes: Part numbers are from the November 2024 parts book, plain RG240T column; the -500 column lists a separate piezo igniter kit, thermostat and pilot thermocouple and the -600 column a different gas control, so check the suffix on the rating plate. The April 2026 revision of the book lists a different T&P valve and drain valve, and the spec sheet says the ICON control (with its built-in piezo igniter and thermopile) may vary by region.

gaps: Suffix columns: the -500 column (page 13) lists piezo igniter kit 243-43450-00, natural gas thermostat 265-46181-02, pilot thermocouple 415-46501-24 and natural gas pilot assembly 233-46277-05 for RG240T; the -600 column (page 11) lists gas control 415-52944-02. None is claimed.
No part number for the thermopile or the built-in piezo igniter appears in the sources, so both are claimed without numbers.
The plain column also lists a natural gas burner, burner assembly, orifice and pilot assembly; data/parts has no burner or pilot type, so they are not claimed.
Anode: the plain column lists magnesium, aluminium and A420 aluminium options; the spec sheet says only 'protective anode rod', so the fitted one is not known.

The ICON, piezo and thermopile wording is from the 2022 spec sheet copy (footer 1101-G-0822, hosted by totalhomesupply.com); Bradford White's current sheet (1101-1125) no longer mentions the piezo igniter or thermopile.
April 2026 parts book revision (#238-51386-00S): T&P valve 415-40594-03 and brass drain valve 415-48070-02 for RG240T; the November 2024 numbers are claimed here.
method: Bradford White Residential Gas Replacement Parts List, Atmospheric Vent, #238-51386-00P (effective November 2024), PDF copy on res.cloudinary (wholesale-plumbing): page 9 (RG240T column, rendered and read), page 11 (-600 column) and page 13 (-500 column).

Bradford White atmospheric vent spec sheet, copy on manuals.totalhomesupply.com (footer 1101-G-0822, (c) 2022 Bradford White): page 1 (ICON system, piezo, thermopile; photo is of RG240T6N). Its own document, no bradfordwhite.com copy with this wording found.
Bradford White atmospheric vent spec sheet 1101-1125 on docs.bradfordwhite.com: page 2 (RG240T6N row).
Bradford White's own copy of the parts list (238-51386-00_Current.pdf, revision S, April 2026) was read for the revision differences.

comps.spec: Gas control, natural gas, direct replacement: Bradford White 415-52907-02 (universal replacement 415-53359-00)
Standard off-the-shelf thermopile for the ICON gas control, heated by the pilot flame to power the gas valve and microprocessor without outside electricity (the sheet says ICON may vary by region)
Built-in piezo igniter in the ICON gas control (the sheet says ICON may vary by region)
Hot water outlet anode rod; the book lists three options for this model: magnesium 415-55482-00, aluminium 415-55484-00 and A420 aluminium 415-55486-00 (may need cutting to length)
Tank rated 40 U.S. gal (33 imp. gal), with a DOE rated storage volume of 38 U.S. gal
